tests.title: Clean local start
tests.expected: Fresh isolated profile with documented prerequisites reaches healthy application and persistent services; no hidden model/provider credentials.

tests.title: Protected bootstrap and authentication
tests.expected: Create organisation and unique local owner; real login/MFA/logout/revocation work; no default-password or role-switch bypass.

tests.title: Tenant and environment isolation
tests.expected: Cross-tenant and unassigned sibling-environment API read/write/export and background-job access denied; DB role cannot bypass configured RLS.

tests.title: Principal and staff separation
tests.expected: Principal A cannot access principal B or workspace APIs; staff/vendor-shaped credentials cannot masquerade as a principal or vendor root.

tests.title: Least privilege and approval
tests.expected: Auditor/member unauthorised writes denied server-side; policy publish by author/self or wrong digest denied; authorised distinct reviewer succeeds.

tests.title: Persisted configuration and relationships
tests.expected: Create purpose, notice, policy, principal and system mapping; reload/restart and read exact immutable published version; unsupported changes rejected.

tests.title: Grant and own receipt
tests.expected: Authenticated affirmative grant stores exact notice/purpose, server epoch and receipt; no unrelated purpose granted.

tests.title: Atomic withdrawal acceptance
tests.expected: Committed receipt corresponds to state/event/outbox; injected pre-commit failure leaves no accepted receipt; refresh shows durable withdrawal.

tests.title: Idempotency and concurrent epochs
tests.expected: Identical authorised retry returns original logical receipt; conflicting key reuse/stale epoch rejected; concurrent grant/withdraw ordering is deterministic.

tests.title: Replay and fresh re-consent safety
tests.expected: Old grant cannot override newer withdrawal; legitimate new interaction advances epoch; stale cleanup cannot mutate a newly authorised target generation.

tests.title: Outbox and worker recovery
tests.expected: Crash/restart after accepted withdrawal resumes stable workflow; duplicate dispatch does not create a second logical operation.

tests.title: Restricted signed commands
tests.expected: Altered/wrong-tenant/wrong-installation/expired command denied; duplicate command reconciles without duplicate effect; arbitrary operation/host/SQL rejected.

tests.title: Actual CRM mutation and readback
tests.expected: Real synthetic CRM membership changes via agent; separate read confirms exact target/scope/generation, not an acknowledgement copied as evidence.

tests.title: Current send-admission enforcement
tests.expected: Queued marketing attempt after committed withdrawal is denied and no send row is written; concurrent case verifies documented admission ordering.

tests.title: Independent service purpose
tests.expected: Service fixture only allowed under its own approved condition/context; missing condition denied; marketing withdrawal does not automatically permit or block every other purpose.

tests.title: Degraded policy safety
tests.expected: OPA timeout/undefined/malformed result is INDETERMINATE and marketing is blocked/queued without send; no fail-open fallback.

tests.title: Applied but response lost
tests.expected: REST sandbox applies change then times out; effect marked unknown; reconciliation obtains read/receipt evidence without blind unsafe retry.

tests.title: Acknowledgement without effect
tests.expected: Sandbox returns success but unchanged target; observation detects mismatch and workflow is not falsely completed.

tests.title: Known failure and bounded retry
tests.expected: Known unavailable/denied target state creates bounded attempts and explicit escalation; errors are not swallowed or retried forever.

tests.title: Manual and missing capability
tests.expected: Legacy no-API target becomes assigned manual requirement; manual attestation not automated verification; permission removal changes coverage.

tests.title: Truthful evidence and dashboard
tests.expected: Receipt/version/plan/observation references match persisted state; unknown/manual/unverified obligations remain visible; counters are not fabricated.

tests.title: Local export protection
tests.expected: Export is authorised, scope-filtered, audited and local; another tenant/principal cannot fetch it; no vendor renderer; limits accompany digest claims.

tests.title: Healthy regression run
tests.expected: Allowlisted synthetic scenario invokes real policy/boundary/target and persists assertion-level PASS/FAIL/ERROR with actual run/build references.

tests.title: Broken fixture detection and repair
tests.expected: Real buggy test-only sender produces a violation, assertion detects it, healthy fixture rerun passes; no result chosen from fault selector.

tests.title: Quarantined target restore
tests.expected: Old target-only synthetic snapshot remains blocked/quarantined until reconciliation against current authoritative withdrawal, then restricted simulated processing stays blocked.

tests.title: No runtime vendor/model egress
tests.expected: Core scenario works with vendor/model internet blocked; browser and backend observations show no unapproved traffic/assets/telemetry for the tested interval.

tests.title: Input/session and secret hygiene
tests.expected: Bounded schemas, CSRF/origin/session errors, log redaction, no committed secrets; dependency/secret scan findings triaged and no unacceptable critical finding.

tests.title: Reset and fault isolation
tests.expected: Named synthetic-only reset requires authorisation/confirmation and rejects non-demo targets; fault/reset unavailable outside profile; parallel lane stores isolated.

tests.title: Integrated browser flow and error states
tests.expected: Staff configure, principal withdraw, workflow/evidence/test views use real API; empty/loading/denied/service errors accessible; refresh retains truth.

tests.title: Frozen-candidate repeatability and claims
tests.expected: Two rehearsals from documented state; evidence matches exact candidate; recording/live distinction and capability claims accurate; no V2 inference advertised.

tests.title: Rights case coordination
tests.expected: Own-principal intake, identity scope, assigned review and status persist; no claim of unimplemented downstream erasure/access fulfilment.

tests.title: Retention/hold review coordination
tests.expected: Typed review case has allowed transitions/permissions and hold reason; no destructive operation or fabricated deletion result.

tests.title: Development licence import
tests.expected: Local verifier accepts valid development fixture, rejects altered/wrong-profile signature; clearly not production commerce or signing; restrictions persist on expiry.

tests.title: Deterministic help
tests.expected: Reviewed rule/runbook points to authorised actual records, labels non-model behaviour; no inference/API/egress and absence does not break core.
